details: On August 12, Bitcoin (BTC) saw a slight slip, falling 0.3% to $63,503.38, while Ethereum (ETH) gained 0.2% to $1,884.51. This came after the U.S. Consumer Price Index (CPI) showed annual inflation easing to 3.4% in July 2026. Despite the cooling inflation, broader market sentiment remained weak, with some analysts suggesting the positive economic news was already priced in, and other factors like stalled crypto legislation continue to weigh on the market.
title: Bitcoin, Ethereum See Mixed Movements After Cooling US Inflation.

details: On August 12, U.S. spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) recorded modest net inflows of $7.8 million. BlackRock's IBIT led these inflows with $50.2 million, though partially offset by outflows from other funds including Fidelity and Ark. This occurred as investors watched for signals regarding potential Federal Reserve interest rate cuts.
title: Spot Bitcoin ETFs Post $7.8M Inflows Ahead of CPI.

details: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has slated pivotal votes on new cryptocurrency rules between August 12-14. These potential regulations could include a token safe-harbor framework and new exemptions for fundraising activities in the crypto space.
title: SEC Set for Key Crypto Rule Votes This Week.

details: The Harmony blockchain suffered an exploit resulting in the unauthorized minting of 4 billion ONE tokens, representing approximately 26% of its total supply, which led to a 26% drop in the ONE token's price. Concurrently, the Coreum bridge also reportedly lost around 200,000 XRP tokens in a 97-minute attack.
title: Harmony & Coreum Bridges Targeted by Exploits.

details: Crypto market maker GSR's Core3 model rebalanced its portfolio on August 13, significantly cutting its Bitcoin (BTC) allocation to 16.9%—the lowest among the three assets it tracks. Concurrently, Solana (SOL) became the model's top holding at 43.6%, overtaking Ether (ETH), following Solana's 2.98% gain over the past week while Bitcoin and Ether declined.
title: GSR Trading Model Boosts Solana Allocation, Reduces Bitcoin.

details: The Bank of England is moving forward with Phase 2 of its digital pound pilot program, which involves Polygon Labs and other partners. The initiative is testing the interoperability of stablecoins and a digital pound for cross-border payments and exploring how to build SME "bankable profiles" using wallet transaction data and business intelligence.
title: Bank of England Piloting Digital Pound with Polygon for Interoperability.
